stories.title: Delays on A55 and M56 eastbound as bank holiday getaway begins
stories.summary: Road closures are in place between Daresbury and Walton Golf Club in Cheshire until Sunday for the Creamfields festival. Queueing traffic has been reported on the approach, with congestion running back to the A56 Chester Road. stories.summary: A scooter has been seized by North Wales Police officers covering north Flintshire, who used the case to warn riders about hiding or removing registration plates. stories.title: North Wales scientists race to measure wildfire damage to UK soils
stories.summary: Scientists at Bangor University are measuring how much damage this summer’s wildfires have done to soils in north Wales, starting with burnt ground near Conwy and Harlech. stories.title: Inspectors find progress across Flintshire adult social care but gaps remain
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council is not currently meeting duties set out in law in eight areas of adult social care, according to a report going before councillors next week.
